decisive_items: A core-needle biopsy of the left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma
Cytologic diagnosis was duct cell carcinoma of both breasts with left axillary lymph node metastasis
the right breast lump was suspected to be a fibroadenoma
response.rationale: Core biopsy confirms infiltrative ductal carcinoma in the left breast, with cytology showing malignant features and axillary metastasis; right lump is only suspected fibroadenoma, not confirmed.

rejected.why: Type 2 diabetes is a comorbidity, not the presenting diagnosis.
Hypertension is a comorbidity, not the presenting diagnosis.
Axillary metastasis is a consequence of the primary carcinoma, not the most likely diagnosis.
